completion_dependencies: manifest, quarantine, verification, atomic activation and rollback tests pass
model terms/approval remains an explicit external state
receipts bind artifact digest, tokenizer digest, manifest digest and rollback identity
no model weight or restricted artifact appears in Git history
evidence_ceiling: Artifact admission proves identity and atomic lifecycle semantics only. Quality, safety, redistribution permission, restricted access and device compatibility remain separate evidence lanes.
goal: Implement a content-addressed, terms-aware model artifact supply chain with quarantine, verification, atomic activation and rollback without committing weights.

handoff_contract.draft_pr_rule: Create a Draft PR only after real implementation bytes and the owning static/local gates exist. A task-packet-only branch must not open a ceremonial PR.
required_fields: consumed parent identities and output digests
positive gates and planted negative controls
evidence lanes and explicit NOT_EXERCISED states

human_owned_operations: merge or retarget any pull request
App Store or Google Play publication
signing, provisioning, credentials, secrets or access grants
model, SDK, store, service or legal terms acceptance
semantic resolution of conflicting public/private/source requirements
production rollback or destructive artifact removal
negative_controls: wrong digest, size, tokenizer or runtime -> FAIL
downgrade or duplicate logical version with different bytes -> FAIL
interrupted activation leaves active partial bytes -> FAIL
model weights or access token committed to Git -> FAIL
non_goals: download or redistribute restricted model weights without Human admission
treat artifact digest as model quality, safety, license or device compatibility proof
store credentials, access tokens, private URLs or model bytes in Git
positive_gates: valid local synthetic artifact activates atomically
interrupted activation leaves no partial active state
receipts bind exact artifact and manifest identities
required_outputs: atomic activation pointer and rollback ledger
Local Handoff for Human-gated download or accepted terms
start_dependencies: P2 ModelArtifactRef and evidence/handoff contracts are readable
P0 keeps source-code, model, dataset, service and SDK/store terms separate
P1 forbids credentials, private locations and access grants from public receipts
stop_conditions: P2 parent head/tree or exact-receipt identity drifts
writer lease overlaps another ACTIVE worker
provider-specific types cross the shared P2 contract boundary
private Workspace URL, resolver value, secret or private decision enters public Git
a cheaper evidence lane is promoted into LIVE_DEVICE, PRIVATE or HUMAN acceptance
a license/terms state is inferred rather than explicitly represented

worker_prompt_envelope.builder: You are the sole implementation writer for this task. Implement only the declared writable lease. Treat all model output and provider output as candidate data until host policy and contract validation admit it.
worker_prompt_envelope.shadow: Run as a separate observer. Classify material deltas as ASSUMPTION, STATE, AUTHORITY, OWNERSHIP, LIFECYCLE, CONCURRENCY, RESOURCE, SIDE_EFFECT, FAILURE, or EVIDENCE. Return L0, L1, L2, or L3 without silently editing implementation.
worker_prompt_envelope.tech_lead: Preserve start-readiness versus completion-readiness, exact-subject receipts, disjoint worker leases, failure falsifiers, and Local Handoff boundaries.
